goal: Extract long- and small-primitive-specific implementations out of BitField into a new helper class to reduce the size and complexity of BitField.

ops.details: Create a new helper class BitFieldSupport in package org.apache.commons.lang3. Move the implementations of the long-specific instance constructor and all long overloads, together with the byte/short wrapper implementations, into BitFieldSupport as static methods that accept mask and shiftCount (or the mask only where appropriate). The new class exposes static methods with signatures corresponding to the moved behavior, e.g. clearLong(long mask, int shiftCount, long holder) (or clearLong(long mask, long holder)), getRawValueLong(long mask, long holder), getValueLong(long mask, int shiftCount, long holder), setValueLong(long mask, int shiftCount, long holder, long value), and analogous methods for byte/short wrappers. This concentrates multi-type logic in one place and reduces BitField's implementation size.
